comment: List prices in USD of the services that a tournament uses, for the cost report of the game day (scripts/rehearsal/cost.mjs, docs/benchmark.md). Firestore in eur3 (multi-region), the API in europe-southwest1 (Cloud Run functions, request-based billing, tier 1). Check them on cloud.google.com/firestore/pricing, cloud.google.com/run/pricing and firebase.google.com/pricing when they change, and the real bill in the Cloud Console (Billing > Reports).

hosting.comment: The web apps and, in production, every answer of the API: the apps call it through Firebase Hosting (/api).

storage.comment: Photos, logos and the Green Book. The bucket is not in a US region, so it has no free tier.
